description:
Execute a raw SQL query against a database service. Only available for services with raw_sql_allowed enabled. Use faucet_list_services to check which services allow raw SQL. Because arbitrary SQL can touch any object, it requires a role rule granting all verbs (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE) on the _sql component of the service.

The statement is executed as-is and may modify data; it is refused on services flagged read_only. Parameters should be passed as an array and referenced with positional placeholders ($1, $2 for PostgreSQL; ?, ? for MySQL).

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return (default 100, max 10000)

params.description: Positional parameters for the SQL query

name: faucet_raw_sql
